# Custom menus API — operations

5 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `custom-menus.create-custom-menu` — **Create Custom Menu Link** — `POST /custom-menus/` (write, agency)
  Creates a new custom menu for a company.
- `custom-menus.delete-custom-menu` — **Delete Custom Menu Link** — `DELETE /custom-menus/{customMenuId}` (write, agency)
  Removes a specific custom menu from the system.
- `custom-menus.get-custom-menu-by-id` — **Get Custom Menu Link** — `GET /custom-menus/{customMenuId}` (read, agency)
  Fetches a single custom menus based on id.
- `custom-menus.get-custom-menus` — **Get Custom Menu Links** — `GET /custom-menus/` (read, agency)
  Fetches a collection of custom menus based on specified criteria.
- `custom-menus.update-custom-menu` — **Update Custom Menu Link** — `PUT /custom-menus/{customMenuId}` (write, agency)
  Updates an existing custom menu for a given company.
